# Vendored packages

Neither package is published to a package index, so both are vendored as source.
Build artifacts are deliberately excluded (see "Not vendored").

| Package | Version | Origin archive | SHA-256 of archive |
|---|---|---|---|
| `epistemic_toolkit/` | 2.0.0 | `epistemic-toolkit-2.0.0.zip` | `2bf769d2d76e8edbc771c45da55be57f716572f4b5d7bc01284fb967f334fffe` |
| `ctd/` | 0.5.1 | `CTD_Unified_Intelligence_Engine_v5.1_COMPLETE.zip` (`source/` tree) | `5ceee982993fe9e7888698b326fc7ae04e1d1c3691668b6339088e4c4b88f636` |

## Verification at import time

| Package | Result |
|---|---|
| epistemic-toolkit | `run.sh` passes: 69/69 tests plus the example build gates. `tests/mutation_check.py` kills 11/11 mutants. |
| CTD | 260/260 tests pass on Python 3.12 once `openpyxl` is installed (see local modifications). All `src/` and `tests/` files match the archive's `release/SHA256SUMS.txt`. |

## Findings in the CTD archive

1. **The recommended wheel was not built from the shipped source.** `dist/constrained_topological_engine-0.5.1-py3-none-any.whl`
   (the one the package README tells you to install) lacks `ctd/oracles.py`. It also differs from the source in
   `authz.py`, `controller.py`, `unified_close.py`, `adapters/__init__.py`, `kernel/close.py`, `kernel/evaluate.py` and
   `kernel/query.py`. Tenant isolation was probed on both builds: untagged and foreign-tenant records are hidden in
   each, so this is not a disclosure regression. It is still not the audited code. **Install from source**
   (`pip install ./third_party/ctd`) and never from that wheel.
2. **Undeclared dependency.** `ctd.adapters.build_addendum` imports `openpyxl`, but `pyproject.toml` did not declare it,
   so one test fails on a clean install.
3. **Stale checksums.** 74 of 222 `SHA256SUMS.txt` lines do not verify. 71 are build and pytest-cache files that
   are not in the archive (harmless). The other 3 (`CHANGELOG.md`, `README_COMPLETE_PACKAGE.md`, `release/MANIFEST.json`) were edited after the
   checksums were generated.
4. **Documentation drift.** The source README still says "Python 3.13+", while `pyproject.toml` (correctly) says `>=3.12`.
   The package README still describes the 0.5.0 wheel.

## Local modifications

| File | Change | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `ctd/pyproject.toml` | `openpyxl` added to the `dev` extra and to a new `adapters` extra | Finding 2 |

No source file under `src/` or `tests/` was modified in either package.

## Not vendored

`dist/` wheels (finding 1), `build/`, `.pytest_cache`, `*.egg-info`, `originals/*.zip` (the pre-merge v4/v5 archives)
and `release/` from CTD; `dist/` (regenerated by `run.sh`) from the toolkit.
